## Problem and scope

What failure, contract or usability problem does this change address? Link the
issue if one exists. Explain any change to the current milestone's scope.

## Evidence

- Expected versus actual behavior:
- Regression that fails before the fix:
- Checks run (`make check`, `make package-check` when relevant):
- Scripted versus live evidence, limitations and omitted data:

## Review

- [ ] I can explain and verify this change, including any AI-assisted code.
- [ ] Evaluation remains independent of the tools/safeguards under test.
- [ ] No secrets, customer data, weights or unreviewed live artifacts are included.
- [ ] Documentation and relevant limitations reflect the actual behavior.

Use “not applicable” with a reason when a technical checklist item does not apply.
